general.title: OMIX GSEA Visualization Legacy
general.instructions:
Create ES, ranked-gene, and leading-edge heatmap plots from three workflow inputs.

1. **MSigDB Database** — the pathway database used by GSEA. It restores pathway membership when a filtered result does not embed it.
2. **Filtered GSEA Results** — one `filtered_gsea_results.csv` from OMIX GSEA Filters.
3. **DEG Analysis Result Bundle** — one combined OMIX DEG Analysis Result containing `DEG_Analysis.csv`, `Sample_Metadata.csv`, and its run summary. The DEG table supplies ranking statistics and the batch-corrected expression values used for leading-edge heatmaps.

Keep the two DEG files together in one Result/Data Asset. Diagnostic images and the run summary are ignored. To override the attached bundle, optionally provide both **DEG Table File** and **Sample Metadata File** below; the two uploaded files are always used together and take precedence.

datasets.name: MSigDB Database
datasets.description: Pathway membership database used by OMIX GSEA. Attach the same MSigDB version used for the upstream GSEA analysis.

datasets.name: Filtered GSEA Results
datasets.description: One `filtered_gsea_results.csv` generated by OMIX GSEA Filters.

datasets.name: DEG Analysis Result Bundle
datasets.description:
One input asset containing DEG results and Sample_Metadata.csv for DEG analysis.

One OMIX DEG Analysis Result with `DEG_Analysis.csv` and `Sample_Metadata.csv` in the same folder. Replace the legacy demo table with a combined result before running.

categories.name: Input Data
categories.description: Default workflow input: MSigDB, filtered GSEA results, and one combined DEG Analysis result bundle. Optionally override the DEG bundle with both explicit file selectors below.

categories.name: Visualization Options
categories.description: Configure what to visualize and how the output is generated

categories.name: ES Plot Options
categories.description: Customize the running enrichment score curve and deviation guide line

categories.name: RNK Plot Options
categories.description: Customize the ranked gene score area in the RNK panel

parameters.name: DEG Table File (Optional)
parameters.description: Optional override for the DEG Analysis Result Bundle. Select or upload the complete DEG table (CSV or RDS), including its ranking-statistic columns and appended normalized or batch-corrected sample-expression columns. You must also provide Sample Metadata File; together, these two files take precedence over the attached bundle.

parameters.name: Sample Metadata File (Optional)
parameters.description: Optional override paired with DEG Table File. Select or upload metadata (CSV or RDS) with one row per DEG-expression sample; by default it uses Sample and Group columns. You must also provide DEG Table File; the two are never mixed with the attached bundle.

parameters.name: Contrast filter mode
parameters.description:
none — include all contrasts (default)
keep — include only the contrasts listed below
remove — include all contrasts except those listed below

parameters.name: Contrasts
parameters.description:
Comma-separated contrast names for keep/remove mode.
Example: Treatment_vs_Control,Drug_vs_Vehicle

Ignored when Contrast filter mode is set to none.

parameters.name: Top pathways per contrast/collection
parameters.description:
Number of top-ranked pathways to plot within each contrast × collection group. Default: 20.
0 = plot all pathways.

parameters.name: Top N by ES sign (up/down separately)
parameters.description:
When TRUE, the Top N limit is applied separately to positively enriched (ES > 0) and negatively enriched (ES < 0) pathways.

Example: Top N = 2 with this ON → up to 2 upregulated + 2 downregulated pathways per contrast × collection.

parameters.name: Write Shared Bubble Plots
parameters.description: Write standardized OMIX pathway-bubble figures and a manifest in addition to the selected legacy GSEA panels.

parameters.name: Shared Bubble Plot Top Pathways
parameters.description: Maximum pathway rows shown in each standardized bubble plot. 0 shows all eligible pathways.

parameters.name: Bubble Plot Significance Statistic
parameters.description: Statistic used for standardized-bubble selection and significance shapes. Adjusted p-value/FDR is the default so pathway tools use the same criterion.

parameters.name: Collection Color Scale
parameters.description: Use independent color limits per collection (default) so smaller collections remain legible, or one shared scale for direct color comparison.

parameters.name: Total plots in PDF
parameters.description:
Global ceiling on the total number of plots written to the PDF, applied after per-group selection.
0 = no limit.
The run log warns when more than 50 plots are about to be generated.

parameters.name: Panels to include
parameters.description:
Select which panels to include in each plot.

ES — Running score (enrichment score curve)
RNK — Ranked gene list (gene score distribution)
LE — Leading edge heatmap (requires expression data)

ES+LE — Enrichment score curve alongside the leading edge heatmap (no RNK panel)

parameters.name: Running score line color
parameters.description: Color of the running enrichment-score curve. ES sign uses red for positive enrichment and blue for negative enrichment; green uses one fixed color.

parameters.name: Peak ES guide
parameters.description: Dashed guide at the peak enrichment score: coordinate draws the vertical rank guide, horizontal draws the score guide, both draws both guides, and none draws neither.

parameters.name: Gene score area color
parameters.description: Fill for the RNK gene-score area: grey or a red/white/blue gradient based on gene score.

parameters.name: Show gene score bar
parameters.description:
Show the colored gene-score rank bar strip and ± sign labels at the bottom of the ES panel.

TRUE — display rank bar (red→white→blue gradient) and +/− signs.
FALSE — hide rank bar and signs; ES curve and rug ticks are unaffected.

parameters.name: Show peak ES guide
parameters.description:
Show a dashed vertical line at the gene rank where the enrichment score peaks — the same x-position as the Peak ES guide in the ES panel above.

TRUE — show dashed vertical guide at peak ES rank (default).
FALSE — no guide.

parameters.name: Show LE highlight
parameters.description:
Show the semi-transparent leading-edge highlight rectangle in the RNK panel.

TRUE — highlight the leading-edge gene region (colored by ES sign).
FALSE — no highlight.

parameters.name: Show LE highlight
parameters.description:
Show the semi-transparent leading-edge highlight rectangle in the ES panel.

TRUE — highlight the leading-edge gene region (colored by ES sign).
FALSE — no highlight.

parameters.name: LE heatmap transform
parameters.description: Transform expression values before drawing the leading-edge heatmap.

parameters.name: Max LE genes in heatmap
parameters.description: Caps each leading-edge heatmap to keep preview and PDF pages readable.

parameters.name: LE heatmap gene ordering
parameters.description: Choose how genes are ordered in the heatmap: **rank** orders genes by leading-edge rank, **cluster** applies hierarchical clustering, and **input** preserves the original gene order. Gene clustering distance and method are used only with `cluster`.

parameters.name: LE heatmap sample ordering
parameters.description: Choose how samples are ordered in the heatmap: **group** orders samples by the selected metadata group, **cluster** applies hierarchical clustering, and **input** preserves the sample order from the expression matrix. Sample clustering distance and method are used only with `cluster`.

parameters.name: Gene clustering distance
parameters.description: Distance measure for gene clustering when gene ordering is cluster. Supported values: euclidean, maximum, manhattan, canberra, binary, minkowski, pearson, spearman, and kendall.

parameters.name: Gene clustering method
parameters.description: Hierarchical linkage method for gene clustering when gene ordering is cluster: ward.D, ward.D2, single, complete, average, mcquitty, median, or centroid.

parameters.name: Sample clustering distance
parameters.description: Distance measure for sample clustering when sample ordering is cluster. Supported values: euclidean, maximum, manhattan, canberra, binary, minkowski, pearson, spearman, and kendall.

parameters.name: Sample clustering method
parameters.description: Hierarchical linkage method for sample clustering when sample ordering is cluster: ward.D, ward.D2, single, complete, average, mcquitty, median, or centroid.

parameters.name: Show LE heatmap gene names
parameters.description: Display gene symbols on heatmap rows.

parameters.name: Show LE heatmap sample names
parameters.description: Display sample names on heatmap columns.

parameters.name: Show leading-edge gene order
parameters.description: When enabled, a number is added before each heatmap gene name, for example **1. MYC** and **2. JUN**. The numbering reflects order within that pathway’s leading-edge subset: 1 is the strongest positively scored gene for an upregulated pathway or the strongest negatively scored gene for a downregulated pathway. This is separate from the gene’s position in the full GSEA ranked list.

parameters.name: LE heatmap gene column
parameters.description: Gene identifier column in `DEG_Analysis.csv` (default: GeneName).

parameters.name: LE heatmap sample column
parameters.description: Column name for sample identifiers in the metadata table (default: Sample).

parameters.name: LE heatmap group column
parameters.description: Column name for sample grouping in the metadata table (default: Group). Used to color heatmap columns.

parameters.name: PDF page width
parameters.description: PDF page width in inches.

parameters.name: PDF page height
parameters.description: PDF page height in inches.
